=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh:154-158 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The usable-output gate in review_round_infra_failure_reason counts any non-empty editor summary as usable unless it contains "editor failed before producing" or "unavailable (editor fallback)". The fallback summaries that review_apply_fixes.sh actually writes after the editor fails contain neither phrase: recoverable_failure at 3046-3070, refusal at 3019-3043 and soft_deadline at 2992-3016. The function therefore returns before it checks any infra signal.
  WHY: Rounds whose editor failed get infra_failed=false. "Commit changes" still runs, no review-round-infra-failed artifact is uploaded, and the round counts toward the sweep cap. The truth-table test only uses hand-written summaries, never the real text. Severity disagreement: four reviewers say BLOCKER and google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite says MAJOR, so the highest is used. Most reviewers say the #9853 no_credential case itself is affected; minimax_minimax-m3 argues that a fallback record handles #9853 and that only rounds with no fallback record are affected.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2623-2644,4034-4056 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On the all_gated capacity-wait path, "Defer review on Claude capacity" exits 1, so the reviewers step is skipped. The "Classify infra-failed review round" step's `if:` requires `steps.reviewers.outcome != 'skipped'`, so the classifier never runs. In addition, the helper's pool regex `^broker_refused_[a-z0-9_]+$` (scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh:172) rejects reason=all_gated.
  WHY: Runs deferred during an all_gated outage upload no infra-failed marker and stay in the sweep's round count. A long outage can still push a PR to SWEEP_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS and park it with ai:needs-human. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite says HIGH and the others say MAJOR, so high is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27580-27598,27660-27700 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The latch selector in release_head_bound_needs_human_latches (`| last`) takes the newest trusted default-heading autofix-cap comment as the latch. The writer's default `*` case does not add ai:needs-human: it adds the label only for llm_failed*|json_parse_failed*|missing_followup_details|merged_pr_unsafe_action|auto_merge_disabled (review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:183-190). An unlabelled newer comment can therefore shadow an older latch whose label binding holds.
  WHY: The binding check fails, every tick skips with label_not_bound_to_latch latch=autofix_cap_head_moved, and the PR stays parked after its head moves. #9862 used to release this case, so this is a regression. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite says HIGH and the others say MAJOR, so high is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27629-27634 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The legacy-comment branch in release_head_bound_needs_human_latches rejects workflow_dispatch runs as latch_head_unverifiable.
  WHY: internal-review.yml supports workflow_dispatch, so legacy autofix-cap comments from those runs stay human-cleared and are not auto-released when the PR head moves.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:pre-push gate report | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The PR failed the pre-push test gate with a shellcheck error.
  WHY: The failing gate blocks future pushes until the error is fixed. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says it could not confirm this failure on the current head (failed_count 0 for d39a1d25).
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4114-4117 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: "Commit changes" skips infra-failed rounds, but "Review pre-push test gate" lacks the same `steps.infra_round.outputs.infra_failed != 'true'` condition and still runs (timeout up to 60 minutes), as asserted in tests/test_review_prepush_test_gate.py:486-494.
  WHY: During the outage this PR targets, every dispatched run spends runner time on a gate whose result is thrown away.
- README.md:307 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The NEEDS_HUMAN_HEAD_LATCH_AUTO_RELEASE_ENABLED row says "Two latches qualify" but lists three, and the separator before "the review-round cap" was dropped.
  WHY: This is documentation only, but it gives operators the wrong number of latch kinds.
- agents.d/9917-needs-human-latch-autofix-cap.md:6 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The fragment says signed repos (AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET) skip release with label_not_bound_to_latch by design. scripts/gh_helpers.sh says valid signed comments are read back with the signing PAT login, so binding would succeed.
  WHY: This misleading documentation may lead maintainers to intervene manually when they do not need to.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27612-27639 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The legacy run-read fallback's gate checks only `type == "object"`, not the shape of the fields, so run JSON that is well-formed but has malformed fields could get through.
  WHY: The field tests at line 27633 bound the impact: a malformed head_sha becomes empty and takes the latch_head_unverifiable path. The reviewer says this is not a real failure path under the current code.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4034-4056 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The classify step sources a sweeper helper and writes its output to GITHUB_OUTPUT and an uploaded artifact, with continue-on-error: true.
  WHY: The reviewer says this does not fail: the reason is constrained to `^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$`, symlinks are rejected, and the step fails open.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Rounds whose editor/reviewer engine failed with `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_REFUSED ... reason=no_credential` (or `all_gated`), or whose pool step logged `CLAUDE_POOL available=false reason=broker_refused_*`, are marked `infra_failed` ... The autofix iteration counter does not advance on an infra_failed iteration."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh review_round_infra_failure_reason (the usable-output gate at lines 154-158)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The gate does not recognize the fallback summaries written at scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:3046-3070 (recoverable_failure), 3019-3043 (refusal) and 2992-3016 (soft_deadline), so rounds whose editor failed, including the #9853 no_credential path, end with infra_failed=false. The test_classifier_truth_table at tests/test_review_round_infra_exclusion.py:178-200 has no case using the real partial-finalize summary text.
- requirement: "Rounds whose editor/reviewer engine failed with `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_REFUSED ... reason=no_credential` (or `all_gated`) ... are marked `infra_failed`."
  expected_change_site: the "Classify infra-failed review round" `if:` in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (line 4036), plus pool-reason handling in scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh (lines 171-174)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The classifier `if:` at review_autofix.yml:4036 excludes rounds where reviewers were skipped, and the all_gated defer step exits 1 first (scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_capacity_wait.sh:35-38). The pool regex at review_sweep_round_cap.sh:171-174 rejects all_gated. The `wait` record is written later, at review_autofix.yml:6177/6179+ (capacity_wait.sh:49). No test covers the capacity-defer step outcome. Deferred rounds therefore stay in the sweep count.
- requirement: "A legacy comment with no head marker is matched by the run's head instead: fetch `.head_sha` of the run URL in the comment."
  expected_change_site: the legacy branch of release_head_bound_needs_human_latches in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: Only pull_request runs on the PR's own branch and repository resolve a head, and workflow_dispatch (sweep-dispatched) runs always skip as latch_head_unverifiable. Neither the PR body nor the changelog says this deviation from the literal requirement leaves those latches for a person. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly judged the restriction to be the only safe reading and not a gap.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh:154-158 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The usable-output gate in review_round_infra_failure_reason (`! grep -qiE 'editor failed before producing|unavailable \(editor fallback\)'`) treats the recoverable_failure summary at review_apply_fixes.sh:3046-3070 as usable, and also the safety-refusal and soft-deadline summaries at 2992-3043. Editor exit 76 (AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_EXIT) does not abort the retry loop.
  WHY: In the #9853 no_credential case the classifier returns empty, so infra_failed=false, Commit runs, the autofix counter advances and no artifact is uploaded. The truth-table test never uses the real summary text. Suggested fix: also treat "Change status: - not-edited" or the partial-finalize phrases as unusable.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2623-2644, 3647 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: On the all_gated path the defer step exits 1 (capacity_wait.sh line 38), so reviewers are skipped and the classifier, gated on `steps.reviewers.outcome != 'skipped'`, never runs. The helper also accepts only `^broker_refused_[a-z0-9_]+$`.
  WHY: Capacity-deferred runs end `failure`, upload no marker and are counted, so a long all_gated outage can still park a PR. Suggested fix: also run when `steps.claude_capacity_wait.outcome == 'failure'` and accept all_gated as a pool signal.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:release_head_bound_needs_human_latches latch selector | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new autofix_cap_head_moved branch feeds `| last`. The default heading (post_review_blocked_comment.sh lines 84-88) is posted unlabelled for most reasons (labels only at lines 183-190), so it can become the newest latch.
  WHY: The release skips with `label_not_bound_to_latch latch=autofix_cap_head_moved` on every tick, a regression from #9862. Suggested fix: count the comment only if it is bound.
- README.md:~307 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The row says "Two latches qualify" but lists three, and a separator is dropped.
  WHY: Documentation only.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: infra_failed marking for no_credential / all_gated / broker_refused_*, with no autofix counter advance. Expected change site: review_sweep_round_cap.sh review_round_infra_failure_reason and the review_autofix.yml classify `if:`. Evidence of absence: the recoverable_failure summary at review_apply_fixes.sh:3046-3070 passes as usable, the all_gated defer skips the classifier, and the tests have no real-summary or capacity-defer case. | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "A legacy comment with no head marker is matched by the run's head instead: fetch `.head_sha` of the run URL in the comment." Expect
